verified_facts.text: The resort is on the Ionian Sea in Costa Navarino, surrounded by centuries-old olive groves, golf courses and a sandy beach.
verified_facts.excerpt: Surrounded by centuries-old olive groves, rolling golf courses and a spectacular sandy beach

verified_facts.text: The Dunes Beach is a sandy, west-facing beach on the Ionian Sea that stretches for 1 km, with sun loungers and umbrellas.
verified_facts.excerpt: The Dunes Beach stretches for 1 km under the warm glow of the Messinian sun. This sandy, west-facing beach, with cozy sun loungers and umbrellas

verified_facts.text: Room and suite design is inspired by old Messinian mansions.
verified_facts.excerpt: inspired in design by old Messinian mansions

verified_facts.text: Many rooms and suites have unobstructed Ionian Sea views, and some ground-floor units have an individual infinity pool.
verified_facts.excerpt: Many rooms and suites enjoy unobstructed views of the Ionian Sea, some ground floor units have an individual infinity pool

verified_facts.text: Anazoe Spa treatments combine ancient Greek healing rituals and local resources such as olive leaves, Messinian citrus, herbs, flowers and sea salts with European spa therapies.
verified_facts.excerpt: All Anazoe Spa treatments are based on progressive techniques that combine ancient Greek healing rituals and local resources with traditional European spa treatments and therapies.

verified_facts.text: The two-level Westin Pool spans two separate pools with a waterfall backdrop.
verified_facts.excerpt: With a distinctive design and a relaxing backdrop of the waterfalls sound, the two-levelled Westin Pool covers a total surface of 851m2 across two separate pools

verified_facts.text: The palm-fringed Lagoon Pool is at the heart of the resort and has a kids' pool.
verified_facts.excerpt: At the heart of the resort, you will find the elegant Lagoon Pool surrounded by palm trees.

verified_facts.text: The seasonal Aqua Park has three slides and a play pool.
verified_facts.excerpt: The Aqua Park, which operates seasonally, and is fun for all ages with three slides and a play pool.

verified_facts.text: The resort has two children's hubs, Cocoon and SandCastle.
verified_facts.excerpt: offering two specially designed hubs for children, Cocoon and SandCastle.

verified_facts.text: Sports programmes for young guests include the NBA Basketball School, Juventus Academy Resort Experience and Mouratoglou Junior Tennis Camp.
verified_facts.excerpt: international sports programmes, including NBA Basketball School, Juventus Academy Resort Experience and Mouratoglou Junior Tennis Camp

verified_facts.text: The Mouratoglou Tennis Center, its first European location, has 12 tennis courts, 3 padel courts and 2 pickleball courts with Ionian Sea views.
verified_facts.excerpt: The first European location for a Mouratoglou Tennis Center offers the opportunity to play on brand new, state-of-the-art courts with breathtaking views of the Ionian Sea

verified_facts.text: The Dunes Course, designed by Bernhard Langer with European Golf Design, is the first signature golf course in Greece, with sea and river views.
verified_facts.excerpt: the impressive seaside Dunes Course is the first signature golf course in Greece, designed by two-time US Masters Champion and former Ryder Cup Captain Bernhard Langer in association with European Golf Design.

verified_facts.text: The 1827 bar is named after the naval battle in the nearby Bay of Navarino during the Greek War of Independence.
verified_facts.excerpt: 1827 is named after one of the most important events of the Greek War of Independence, the famous naval battle that took place in the nearby Bay of Navarino.

verified_facts.text: The resort is a 45-minute drive from Kalamata Airport and three hours from Athens Airport.
verified_facts.excerpt: Located just a 45-minute drive from Kalamata Airport and three hours from Athens Airport
